assertions.title: Landing page renders and adapts to auth state

steps.action: Open / while signed out in a clean session.
steps.expected: The landing page shows the hero, capability cards, How It Works flow, footer, and a signed-out primary CTA to /sign-up.
steps.observed: The signed-out landing page rendered the hero copy, capability sections, How It Works content, footer, and a primary CTA labelled "Sign Up & Start Building".

steps.action: Authenticate with the isolated account and revisit /.
steps.expected: The primary CTA changes to Open Dashboard and the auth chip resolves to the signed-in user email.
steps.observed: After authenticating the isolated account, / rendered an "Open Dashboard" CTA and the auth chip resolved to "Signed in: frontend-hardening-ut+auth-round3-7d36@example.com".

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed on the landing page during signed-out and signed-in checks
evidence.network: Landing CTA hrefs resolved to /sign-up (signed out) and Open Dashboard (signed in). Corroborating curl.exe replay: POST /api/v1/auth/signin/password -> 202, GET /api/v1/operations/op_fdcbeb4864f58af418e4fb6e -> succeeded, POST /api/v1/auth/session/exchange -> 200, GET /api/v1/auth/me -> 200 for frontend-hardening-ut+auth-round3-7d36@example.com.

steps.action: Open /sign-in and enter the isolated test email.
steps.expected: Continue enables for a valid email and reveals the password step.
steps.observed: Continue enabled for the valid email and revealed the password field.

steps.action: Inspect the second-step links.
steps.expected: Forgot your password? points to /reset-password?email=... and Email sign-in code points to /magic-code?email=....
steps.observed: Forgot your password? resolved to /reset-password?email=frontend-hardening-ut%2Bauth-round3-7d36%40example.com and Email sign-in code resolved to /magic-code?email=frontend-hardening-ut%2Bauth-round3-7d36%40example.com.

steps.action: Submit an invalid password and then the valid password.
steps.expected: Invalid credentials show an inline error; valid credentials redirect to /get-started.
steps.observed: The invalid attempt stayed on /sign-in and rendered the inline error "invalid credentials". Re-entering the correct password redirected to /get-started.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during the sign-in page checks
evidence.network: curl.exe corroboration: POST /api/v1/auth/signin/password -> 202, GET /api/v1/operations/op_fdcbeb4864f58af418e4fb6e -> succeeded, POST /api/v1/auth/session/exchange -> 200 user payload, GET /api/v1/auth/me -> 200 for frontend-hardening-ut+auth-round3-7d36@example.com.

steps.action: Open /sign-up and enter the isolated test email.
steps.expected: Continue enables and reveals the password step.
steps.observed: The valid email enabled Continue and revealed the password field.

steps.action: Try a short password and then a valid password.
steps.expected: A short password keeps Create account disabled, while a 10+ character password enables submission.
steps.observed: The Create account button stayed disabled for "short" and became enabled for the assigned 12-character test password.

steps.action: Submit the form and inspect the alternate auth link.
steps.expected: Successful sign-up redirects to /get-started, and the Sign in link navigates to /sign-in.
steps.observed: Submitting the new-account form redirected the browser to /get-started for the isolated account, and the alternate Sign in link resolved to /sign-in.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during the sign-up flow
evidence.network: The browser URL changed to /get-started immediately after Create account. A later curl.exe password sign-in replay for the same account succeeded, confirming the account was created and usable.

assertions.title: Magic-code (passwordless) flow works end-to-end

steps.action: Open /magic-code?email=<isolated-email>.
steps.expected: The email is prefilled, the request auto-sends, and six OTP inputs appear.
steps.observed: The page prefilled frontend-hardening-ut+auth-round3-7d36@example.com, rendered six OTP inputs immediately, showed a disabled Resend now button, and displayed an inline email preview containing the literal placeholder <one_time_code>.

steps.action: Exercise OTP keyboard navigation.
steps.expected: Typing advances focus, ArrowLeft moves back, and Backspace from an empty next field moves back and clears the previous digit.
steps.observed: Typing 1 advanced focus from digit 1 to digit 2, ArrowLeft moved focus back to digit 1, and Backspace from the empty second field returned focus to digit 1 and cleared the entered digit.

steps.action: Enter an invalid 6-digit code.
steps.expected: Entering all 6 digits auto-submits, shows an inline invalid-code error, and resets the digit inputs.
steps.observed: Typing 123456 auto-submitted and reset all six inputs back to blank, but the page never rendered an inline "Invalid one-time code" message in visible body text.

steps.action: Wait for resend availability and attempt the happy path if reachable.
steps.expected: Resend now becomes available and a valid code can complete the redirect to /get-started.
steps.observed: Resend now remained disabled after the cooldown window, and a corroborating curl.exe replay showed POST /api/v1/auth/magic-code/request failing with internal_error "actor not found", so the happy path was not reachable.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed on the magic-code page itself
evidence.network: curl.exe corroboration: POST /api/v1/auth/magic-code/request -> 202 then GET /api/v1/operations/op_a6484a0bf38a273b71ba909e -> failed internal_error "actor not found". POST /api/v1/auth/magic-code/verify with 123456 -> 202 then GET /api/v1/operations/op_4a49a430b228bc7896098a90 -> failed unauthorized "invalid one-time code".

assertions.issues: The passwordless flow did not meet the contract: the request operation failed upstream, the happy path could not be reached, Resend now never enabled, and the browser reset invalid OTP entry without surfacing the required inline invalid-code error.

assertions.title: Reset-password flow works

steps.action: Open /reset-password?email=<isolated-email>.
steps.expected: The email is prefilled.
steps.observed: The email field was prefilled with frontend-hardening-ut+auth-round3-7d36@example.com.

steps.action: Use the Back to sign-in link.
steps.expected: The link navigates back to /sign-in.
steps.observed: The back link resolved to /sign-in and clicking it returned the browser to /sign-in.

steps.action: Submit the reset-password form.
steps.expected: The page shows the reset-instructions success flash or a normal user-facing error state.
steps.observed: The page stayed on /reset-password and rendered the exact inline error text "actor not found" instead of the expected reset-instructions outcome.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed on the reset-password page
evidence.network: curl.exe corroboration: POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password/request -> 202 then GET /api/v1/operations/op_6325d3fa5ea2043a46458c00 -> failed internal_error "actor not found".

assertions.issues: Reset-password did not provide the expected success flash or a normal user-facing recovery path; it exposed an internal actor error instead.

steps.action: Open /get-started while signed out.
steps.expected: The topbar shows the active workspace label, signed-out state, and the no-project hint.
steps.observed: The signed-out dashboard showed "Current view: Pipeline", "Signed out", and "Create a project in Projects view".

steps.action: Open /get-started while signed in with the isolated account.
steps.expected: The topbar shows the signed-in email branch and the workspace context.
steps.observed: The signed-in dashboard showed "Current view: Pipeline", the API context label, the email frontend-hardening-ut+auth-round3-7d36@example.com, and a visible Sign Out control.

evidence.consoleErrors: Signed-in dashboard: none observed. Signed-out dashboard: one expected browser error, "Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized)", while anonymous dashboard requests hit auth-gated APIs.
evidence.network: Signed-in state was corroborated with curl.exe via POST /api/v1/auth/signin/password -> succeeded operation, POST /api/v1/auth/session/exchange -> 200, and GET /api/v1/auth/me -> 200 for the same email.

steps.action: Reach the authenticated dashboard state for the isolated account.
steps.expected: A Sign Out control is visible in the dashboard topbar.
steps.observed: The signed-in dashboard rendered a visible Sign Out control beside the isolated account email.

steps.action: Click Sign Out.
steps.expected: The app clears auth state and redirects to landing or sign-in.
steps.observed: Clicking Sign Out redirected the browser to /sign-in, and subsequent signed-out checks showed unauthenticated dashboard/landing UI.

steps.action: Corroborate the cleared auth state against the backend.
steps.expected: The signout API succeeds and /api/v1/auth/me rejects the cleared session.
steps.observed: A curl.exe replay returned POST /api/v1/auth/signout -> {"ok":true}, and a follow-up GET /api/v1/auth/me with the same cookie jar returned 401.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during the signout click and redirect
evidence.network: Browser click redirected to /sign-in. Corroborating curl.exe replay: POST /api/v1/auth/signout -> {"ok":true}; GET /api/v1/auth/me with the same cookie jar -> 401.

frictions.description: The initial agent-browser instance for session 7d36c99fcfde__u1 hung after the first successful sign-up redirect, so later snapshots/navigation calls timed out until the validator restarted only that assigned daemon/browser process tree.
frictions.resolution: Restarted only the hung u1 agent-browser daemon and its child chrome-headless-shell processes, then continued in the same assigned session name without touching other validators.

frictions.description: agent-browser get text body on these Next.js routes includes the streamed __next_f payload after the visible page text, which made direct text inspection noisy.
frictions.resolution: Filtered the page text with Select-String so only the visible auth/topbar copy relevant to each assertion was captured in notes.

blockers.description: The magic-code request operation for the isolated account still fails immediately with internal_error "actor not found", which prevented any real happy-path verification and kept the Resend now button unavailable.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried the browser flow multiple times, waited through the resend cooldown, and replayed POST /api/v1/auth/magic-code/request plus POST /api/v1/auth/magic-code/verify via curl.exe. The request operation consistently failed with actor not found.

summary: Tested 7 assigned auth-surface assertions against the round-3 source-built frontend/backend stack. 5 passed (landing, sign-in, sign-up, topbar, signout) and 2 failed: magic-code still breaks end-to-end because the request operation fails with actor not found and the UI does not show the required invalid-code error, while reset-password surfaces the internal actor error instead of the expected reset outcome.
